source_refs.note: iii) Transition Elements: a main subheading of 1.5 Families in the periodic table, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 5-5.

blocks.text: Transition metals periodic table ke beech mein elements ki sab se bari family hain. In mein d-block elements ki chaar series aur neeche wali do rows ke lanthanides aur actinides (f-block elements) shamil hain. In ki thermal aur electrical conductivity zyada, melting point zyada, density zyada hoti hai, aur in ki oxidation states badalti rehti hain (variable oxidation states). Yeh aksar coloured (rangeen) compounds banate hain.
